name: maker-select-used-click-shift
about: The top face's outline used; click its front line, Shift-click the front-left arc, Shift-click the line again (toggled off), then right-click the arc (its menu with one used curve selected); Escape twice
source: lead 11-27: the maker flow (the user's own: a part with filleted / spline outlines, a sketch on its face, Use, Offset, chain selection, dimensions and constraints to used geometry, Extrude, Fillet of tangent chains)
